{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the dtype of the 'revenue' column
print("Revenue dtype:", sales_df['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for non-numeric values in the revenue column
non_numeric_revenue = sales_df['revenue'].apply(lambda x: isinstance(x, str) and x.strip() == '' or x is None)
print("Non-numeric revenue entries:", non_numeric_revenue.sum())

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for NaN values after conversion
nan_revenue = sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum()
print("NaN revenue entries:", nan_revenue)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for NaN in revenue among completed orders
nan_in_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].isna().sum()
print("NaN revenue in completed orders:", nan_in_completed)

# Compute the mean revenue for completed orders, excluding NaN
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
